name: Bill Kunik
research_summary: Kunik's AEM profile does not describe a research program, but a published aircraft air-data study acknowledges his assistance. That project modeled sensor-system faults, including pressure-probe blockages, and developed methods to detect them; the quiz covers this documented project rather than an assumed current research agenda.

quiz.question: What aircraft system was the focus of the documented project?

choices: To identify unreliable aircraft information and support safety
quiz.answer: To identify unreliable aircraft information and support safety
